name: Gardeners
description: Oltec specialists with staves and Echoes who fight the Mycotyrant.

description_citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6

timeline.summary: The gardeners arrive and summon Echoes anchored to heirloom objects.
timeline.quote: Spirits burst into existence, anchored to the items.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal sends the gardeners to preserve the land while the Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil.
timeline.quote: While our Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil, you must preserve the land for their return.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Gardeners burn mycoids with waves of pink light.
timeline.quote: Every fungus the light touched burst into flames.
